standard-dialogue.npc: 'Ello, and what are you after then?

options.text: I need another assignment.

steps.player: I need another assignment.

steps.text: If the player has a high combat level:

steps.npc: You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Chaeldar in Zanaris to assign you a task?

options.text: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.

steps.player: No that's okay, I'll take a task from you.

options.text: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.

steps.player: Oh okay then, I'll go talk to Chaeldar.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have an assignment yet:

steps.npc: Excellent, you're doing great. Your new task is to kill [amount] [task monster].

steps.text: If the player already has an assignment:

steps.npc: You're still hunting [task monster], you have [amount] to go.

steps.text: If the assignment isn't on Aya's task list:

steps.npc: Although, it's not an assignment that I'd normally give... I guess I could give you a new assignment, if you'd like.
If you do get a new one, you will reset your standard task streak of [task streak amount]. Is that okay? It won't affect your Wilderness task streak of [task streak amount].

options.text: Yes, please.
No, thanks.

steps.player: No, thanks.

steps.text: If the player already has an assignment, and they have become ineligible for this assignment:

steps.npc: You're still hunting [monster], with [amount] to go.
I don't think that's a suitable task for you. Shall I cancel it? This will not wipe your task streaks.

options.text: Yes, please cancel it.

steps.player: Yes, please cancel it.

steps.npc: Alright, consider the task cancelled. You can now get a new assignment when you want one.

options.text: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.

steps.npc: No, thanks, I want to try doing it.
Good luck with that.

steps.text: If the assignment is on Aya's task list:

options.text: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?

steps.player: Have you any rewards for me, or anything to trade?

steps.npc: I have quite a few rewards you can earn, and a wide variety of Slayer equipment for sale.

options.text: Look at rewards.
Look at shop.
Cancel.
Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.player: Let's talk about the difficulty of my assignments.

steps.text: If the player has disabled combat checking:

steps.npc: The Slayer Masters may currently assign you any task in our lists, regardless of your combat level.

options.text: That's fine - I can handle any task.

steps.player: That's fine - I can handle any task.

steps.npc: That's the spirit.

options.text: In future, please don't give anything too tough.

steps.player: In future, please don't give anything too tough.

steps.npc: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.

steps.text: Slayer Masters will now take the player's combat level into account.
If the player has enabled combat checking:

steps.npc: The Slayer Masters will take your combat level into account when choosing tasks for you, so you shouldn't get anything too hard.

options.text: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.

steps.player: That's fine - I don't want anything too tough.

steps.npc: Okay, we'll keep checking your combat level.

options.text: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!

steps.player: Stop checking my combat level - I can take anything!

steps.npc: Okay, from now on, all the Slayer Masters will assign you anything from their lists, regardless of your combat level.

steps.text: Slayer Masters will no longer take the player's combat level into account.

options.text: I'm here about blessed axes again.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have a blessed axe in their inventory:

steps.player: Hello, I'm here about the blessed axe again.

steps.npc: I suppose you want a new axe?

options.text: Actually, yes.

steps.player: Actually, yes.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have either a mithril axe or a holy symbol in their inventory:
If the player has a mithril axe and a holy symbol in their inventory:

steps.npc: Here's the replacement; be more careful with this one, eh?

options.text: I can do without for now, thanks.

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.npc: Goodbye, then. You may, of course, return if you decide you want a new axe.

steps.text: If the player has a blessed axe in their inventory:

steps.player: Hello, I'm here about the blessed axe again.

steps.npc: You already have an axe in your bag but you want another?

options.text: Actually, yes.

steps.player: Actually, yes.

steps.text: If the player doesn't have either a mithril axe or a holy symbol in their inventory:
If the player has a mithril axe and a holy symbol in their inventory:

steps.npc: Here's the replacement; be more careful with this one, eh?

options.text: I can do without for now, thanks.

steps.player: Not right now.

steps.npc: Goodbye, then. You may, of course, return if you decide you want a new axe.

options.text: So you're filling in for Turael?

steps.player: So you're filling in for Turael?

steps.npc: That I am. It's been quite a while since I last did this sort of thing, but my brother wants one last adventure, so here I am.

steps.player: So you've done this before?

steps.npc: Oh yes. In fact, I was doing it before my brother was. Back in his adventuring days, I was the one here teaching people the basics.
After Spria was born, he retired from his life of thrill- seeking. That's when he took over from me.

steps.player: Interesting... I never knew that.

steps.npc: He doesn't talk about his adventures much, but once you get him going, you won't be able to make him stop!

options.text: About Turael...

steps.player: About Turael...

steps.npc: You need not share your condolences with me, adventurer. I've been prepared for this for a long time.

steps.player: You have?

steps.npc: My brother was a thrill-seeker his whole life. Even after he retired, I always knew something would come and pull him back in.

steps.player: And that something was me. I'm sorry...

steps.npc: Don't be. He died doing what he loved, and he died a hero. He wouldn't have had it any other way.

options.text: Er... Nothing...

steps.player: Er... Nothing...
